responsibility: Implements the unwindable scoped tables used by dominator-based optimizers to track available expressions, condition facts, and const/copy equivalences. It manages a stack-backed expression hash table with block markers for fast push/pop during dominator walks, simplifies expressions using known equalities, records edge- and condition-derived boolean facts, and provides the backing behavior for DOM’s avail_exprs_stack and const_and_copies abstractions.
same_name_distinction: This file provides the executable behavior of the scoped-table abstractions: stack push/pop unwinding, available-expression lookup/simplification, and recording of edge/condition facts used during dominator walks and threading support. The companion gcc/tree-ssa-scopedtables.h only declares those classes, element types, and helper interfaces.
